scope: Model/editor semantic and pedagogy review of Lesson 0135 after spaced-retrieval repair; not an independent human or real-learner test.

englishNaturalness.evidence: Core remember dialogue is grammatical and natural; A09-A14 reuse previously taught natural targets: This information is for you; My mind is clear now; It was two days ago; We can talk after class; That guy is Sam; This is my hand.

persianMeaningQuality.evidence: Persian prompts for the six spaced-retrieval items preserve the previously taught meanings and contain no unsupported contextual claims.

pedagogicalClarity.evidence: A02 exposes current-dialogue context before dependent current-lesson tasks; A09-A14 are explicit prior-lesson retrieval prompts whose required semantic content is fully present in the Persian prompt and was taught in Lessons 125-130.

distractorQuality.evidence: Existing English choice distractors remain grammatical, natural and explicitly audited; the added retrieval activities contain no distractors.

dialoguePlausibility.evidence: The core Liam/Leo library exchange remains coherent and the spaced-retrieval block is clearly separated as review rather than invented story dialogue.

difficultyFit.evidence: The lesson keeps one new A1 target and adds short, already-learned retrieval items rather than introducing new meanings.

repetitionUsefulness.evidence: remember is practiced across recognition, dialogue, reconstruction and retrieval; six overdue targets from Lessons 125-130 now receive active spaced retrieval.

transferQuality.evidence: Current target transfer remains intact, while A09-A14 independently reactivate prior targets within the policy window.

overallCoherence.evidence: New material is labeled and structured as spaced review, so it does not alter the main remember outcome or story semantics.

learnerExperience.evidence: Dependency order was re-audited and the added review prompts are self-contained; no real learner test is claimed.

runtimeAssetGrounding.evidence: No added activity claims an image, photo, visual, or listening source. Existing listening/reconstruction tasks still point only to audioRequired turns exposed earlier by A02.

limitations: No independent human or real learner test has been performed.
Only the recall-from-memory sense of remember is assessed as new content.
The six added spaced-retrieval prompts are model/editor reviewed but not learner-tested.
Generated audio pronunciation/prosody is not evaluated at this text stage.
Runtime behavior still requires CI validation.
